subject: ISO readiness: compact evidence pack + execution-log samples
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@sabletech.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sabletech.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISO readiness — compact pack request and sample logs

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the conversation last week. SableTech is progressing through our vendor ISO 27001 scoping and we'd like to request a compact evidence pack that demonstrates Redwood's controls in scope for our dataflow profile. To keep the intake small for our InfoSec team, could you provide: 

- A one-page mapping of Redwood controls to ISO clauses (concise CSV/CSVX works)
- 1–2 sample execution logs showing KMS rotation and key usage (redacted as needed)
- A short summary of how asset inventory is exported for audits (format + example)
- Any current ISO 27001 certificate statements or SOC 2 summary (PDF)

I've attached our questionnaire (sabletech-questionnaire.xlsx) with a few targeted yes/no checks and a column for links to artifacts.

We'd ideally like these items by EOD Wednesday (14 July) to keep our assessment on schedule. Also happy to run a 30-minute sync if that's easier.

Appreciate your help — Dana

--
Dana Liu
Senior Security Analyst | SableTech Inc.
dana.liu@sabletech.com

From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@sabletech.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISO readiness — compact pack request and sample logs

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. We're happy to assemble a compact pack for SableTech. High-level plan: 

1) Deliverables by Wed EOD (14 Jul):
   - ISO control-to-clause CSV (iso_scope_map.csv)
   - One-page SOC 2 / ISO hybrid summary (redwood_iso-soc2-summary.pdf)
   - Asset inventory export example (asset_inventory_export.jsonl) — sanitized
   - Sample KMS rotation/usage snippet (kms_rotation_log_sample.txt) — redacted

2) Action owners: Aditya will pull the logs + inventory exports; Lauren will validate redaction and legal language for the PDF; I will map the controls and assemble the CSV.

3) Quick sync: we can do 30 min on Tue 13 Jul at 10:00am PT if that works for your team. If you'd prefer, we can upload the artifacts to a short-lived Drive folder and share links.

I'll attach the files when ready and include direct references to questionnaire rows so your team can match answers quickly.

Best,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, Dana Liu <dana.liu@sabletech.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 07:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISO readiness — compact pack request and sample logs

Hi Dana / Hannah — quick update from the artifact side: 

- Attached: asset_inventory_export.jsonl (sample with asset ids + types; PII removed)
- Attached: kms_rotation_log_sample.txt (5-line excerpt showing rotation events and key-usage counts; timestamps in UTC)
- Attached: redwood_iso-soc2-summary.pdf (one-page hybrid summary and scope statement)

Notes on redaction and provenance: the inventory export is generated nightly by our Inventory Service (UUIDs, hostnames, role tags). The KMS rotation snippets are pulled from our internal telemetry pipeline; we removed absolute ARNs and replaced them with role-scoped placeholders. If SableTech needs raw ARNs for attestation, we can arrange a controlled disclosure under an NDA and an access window.

Drive folder (short-lived): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-sabletech-iso-dash
Doc tracking ticket: SEC-572

Hannah: I've also inline-mapped the questionnaire rows to the CSV columns so matching should be straightforward.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- asset_inventory_export.jsonl (attachment stub)
- kms_rotation_log_sample.txt (attachment stub)
- redwood_iso-soc2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@sabletech.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sabletech.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISO readiness — compact pack request and sample logs

Thanks Hannah / Aditya — this is exactly what we needed and the drive link works. A couple quick items: 

- Our InfoSec reviewer asked for the CSV mapping to include the control owner contact (email) where available. Can you add a column with owner?
- For the KMS snippet: the rotation timestamps look good. We'll accept placeholders for the ARNs for now.
- We can do the 30-minute sync Tue 13 Jul at 16:00 PT if either of you can join — we'll invite our security reviewer (Samir).

If you can drop an updated CSV with an owner column before the sync, that would be helpful. Otherwise, we'll proceed and mark the account as "in review".

Thanks again — Dana
